values.meaning: duration of the root applied to the last champion struck

mechanics.claim: Zenith Blade deals magic damage to enemies hit by the sword in flight.
mechanics.quote: projects her sword in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: If the sword hits an enemy champion, Leona dashes to and roots the last champion struck after the sword reaches max range.
mechanics.quote: if the sword hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} during its flight, '''Leona''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to 225 units beyond the location of the last champion struck and {{tip|root|roots}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Leona is unable to move or attack while the sword is in flight, but can cast other abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Leona''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Zenith Blade is in flight. She can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Leona automatically basic attacks the target she dashed to after the dash completes, which can chain into an on-hit/attack reset opportunity.
mechanics.quote: '''Leona''' will be ordered to basic attack the target she dashed to, after her dash completes.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the damage and prevents Leona from dashing to the shielded target.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage, and prevent '''Leona''' from dashing as the last champion struck by her sword.
